title: config/ci.json
description: Existing Make targets needed before and around the shared gates (`scripts/kit/ci-setup.mts`): repository-specific install and generation prerequisites grouped by shared checks, parity, and runtime. Optional contexts name paired repository-owned preparation and cleanup targets around each provider gate. `parityMode` selects the provider full gate (the default) or the provider-owned API and implementation-binding phases.

runner.description: The supported GitHub-hosted runner for gate jobs. The default is Ubuntu 24.04 x64; repositories may select Ubuntu 26.04 ARM when their native database tooling requires it.

parityMode.description: The parity path of the provider gates workflow. `full` (default) runs complete parity-check; `phases` runs the global API phase and one binding phase for every implementation in config/parity.json.

contexts.description: Optional paired existing Make targets for repository-owned CI resources. Preparation runs after locked install/build setup immediately before the provider gate. Cleanup runs with always() after preparation was entered, including when preparation or the gate fails.

tools.description: Optional extra pinned tools required by a shared/parity/runtime setup target. Values name existing Kit tool selectors, never commands.

targets.description: Existing no-argument Make targets. A nonempty runtime list replaces Kit defaults and must name every required setup target for that runtime; an empty runtime list uses Kit's native locked installation/build targets. The full `install` and `install-kit` aggregates are forbidden.
